fieldData.name: Brooklyn Neighborhoods: A Practical Renter's Orientation
fieldData.post-summary: Brooklyn contains more than 70 distinct neighborhoods spread across 71 square miles, with median one-bedroom rents ranging from roughly $2,000 in Bay Ridge to $5,900 in DUMBO. This guide organizes the major brooklyn neighborhoods by geography, rent, and subway access so renters can narrow a shortlist based on commute time, monthly cost, and daily infrastructure.
fieldData.meta-description: Brooklyn has 70+ neighborhoods with 1BR rents from $2,000 to $5,900. Compare major areas by rent, subway access, and lifestyle for your apartment search.
